verdict.rationale: Community evidence confirms official alternate desktop-environment variants exist and are used in practice (e.g., 'Fedora 39 KDE Spin has been flawless', GNOME vs KDE comparisons), but the first-party evidence pack only documents the default GNOME-based Workstation experience and never itself describes the Spins program or how to choose among variants. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of Fedora Spins/Labs, explicit listing of default-app differences across variants, and independent corroboration beyond KDE Spin mentions.
